$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$launchTime = [datetimeoffset]'2026-08-20T14:41:11+08:00'
$log = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\dell\Documents\powertoollogs' -File |
    Sort-Object LastWriteTime |
    Select-Object -Last 1
$lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log.FullName
$timestampPattern = '^(?<stamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3} [+-]\d{2}:\d{2})'
$currentStamp = $null
$sessionLines = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]
foreach ($line in $lines) {
    if ($line -match $timestampPattern) {
        $currentStamp = [datetimeoffset]::ParseExact(
            $matches.stamp,
            'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz',
            [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
        )
    }
    if ($null -ne $currentStamp -and $currentStamp -ge $launchTime) {
        $sessionLines.Add($line)
    }
}

$evidenceDirectory = 'C:\Users\dell\Documents\MaximPowerToolReadonly\evidence'
$sessionPath = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'powertool_session_20260820_144111.log'
$sessionLines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $sessionPath -Encoding UTF8

Write-Output ('LOG={0}' -f $log.FullName)
Write-Output ('LOG_LENGTH={0}' -f (Get-Item -LiteralPath $log.FullName).Length)
Write-Output ('LOG_LAST_WRITE={0:o}' -f (Get-Item -LiteralPath $log.FullName).LastWriteTime)
Write-Output ('SESSION_LINES={0}' -f $sessionLines.Count)
Write-Output ('SESSION_FILE={0}' -f $sessionPath)

$patterns = [ordered]@{
    selected_powertool = 'Selected PowerTool'
    device_id = 'IC_DEVICE_ID'
    revision = 'revision'
    filename = 'fileName'
    xml_loaded = 'Xml file loaded'
    opening_xml = 'Opening xml'
    read_devices = 'Reading devices|read devices|Search For Devices|Scanning|scan'
    clear_faults = 'CLEAR_FAULT'
    error = '\[ERR\]|Could not find|Error opening|Exception|fail|Fault'
}
foreach ($entry in $patterns.GetEnumerator()) {
    $matchesForPattern = @($sessionLines | Select-String -Pattern $entry.Value)
    Write-Output ('COUNT_{0}={1}' -f $entry.Key.ToUpperInvariant(), $matchesForPattern.Count)
    if ($matchesForPattern.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Output ('=== {0} LAST 40 ===' -f $entry.Key.ToUpperInvariant())
        $matchesForPattern | Select-Object -Last 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
    }
}

Write-Output '=== SESSION HEAD ==='
$sessionLines | Select-Object -First 160
Write-Output '=== SESSION TAIL ==='
$sessionLines | Select-Object -Last 160

    audit_il_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $auditIl -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

    getter_call_lines = @($content | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'Resources::get__004328()').Count
    getter_definition_lines = @($content | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'get__004328() cil managed').Count

    device_lost_calls = @($content | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'call       instance void MaximDigitalPower.MainWindow::deviceLost').Count

$elements = $root.FindAll([Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $condition)

$uiaFile = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'powertool_current_uia.tsv'

$result = [ordered]@{

    process_id = $process.Id
    process_path = $process.Path

    main_window_title = $process.MainWindowTitle

$process = Get-Process -Id $safeResult.process_id -ErrorAction Stop
if ($process.Path -ne $safeResult.executable) { throw 'Unexpected stable executable path.' }

$bounds = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VirtualScreen
$bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $bounds.Width, $bounds.Height
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
try {
    $graphics.CopyFromScreen($bounds.Left, $bounds.Top, 0, 0, $bounds.Size)

    $bitmap.Save($screenshot, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
}
finally {

    $bitmap.Dispose()

$root = [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement
$condition = New-Object Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition(
    [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ProcessIdProperty,
    [int]$process.Id
)
$elements = $root.FindAll([Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $condition)
$lines = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]
$tabItems = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]
for ($index = 0; $index -lt $elements.Count; $index++) {
    $element = $elements.Item($index)
    $lines.Add(('{0}`t{1}`t{2}`t{3}`tEnabled={4}`tOffscreen={5}' -f `

        $element.Current.AutomationId,
        $element.Current.ControlType.ProgrammaticName,
        $element.Current.ClassName,
        $element.Current.IsEnabled,
        $element.Current.IsOffscreen))
    if ($element.Current.ControlType -eq [Windows.Automation.ControlType]::TabItem) {
        $tabItems.Add($element.Current.Name.Trim())
    }
}
$uiaFile = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'stable_powertool_uia.tsv'
$lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $uiaFile -Encoding UTF8

$result = [ordered]@{
    timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
    process_id = $process.Id

    process_uptime_s = ((Get-Date) - $process.StartTime).TotalSeconds
    responding = $process.Responding
    main_window_title = $process.MainWindowTitle
    element_count = $elements.Count
    tab_items = @($tabItems)
    has_0x11_tab = @($tabItems) -contains '0x11'
    screenshot = $screenshot
    uia_file = $uiaFile
}
$result | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'stable_capture_result.json') -Encoding UTF8
$result | ConvertTo-Json

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationTypes
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$rootDirectory = 'C:\Users\dell\Documents\MaximPowerToolReadonly'
$evidenceDirectory = Join-Path $rootDirectory 'evidence'
$safeResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_launch_result.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$resultPath = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_rescan_completed.json'
$process = Get-Process -Name MaximDigitalPower -ErrorAction Stop

if ($safeResult.mux -ne 'Off' -or $safeResult.clear_faults_after -ne 'Off') {
    throw 'Initial safe-launch contract is not satisfied.'
}
if ($process.Path -ne $safeResult.executable) {
    throw "Unexpected executable: $($process.Path)"
}

function Find-Element {
    param(
        [int]$ProcessId,
        [string]$AutomationId,
        [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 20
    )
    $desktop = [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement
    $processCondition = New-Object Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition(
        [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ProcessIdProperty,
        $ProcessId
    )
    $idCondition = New-Object Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition(
        [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::AutomationIdProperty,
        $AutomationId
    )
    $condition = New-Object Windows.Automation.AndCondition($processCondition, $idCondition)
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($TimeoutSeconds)
    do {
        $element = $desktop.FindFirst([Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $condition)
        if ($null -ne $element) { return $element }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
    } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)
    throw "UI element not found: $AutomationId"
}

function Save-DesktopScreenshot {
    param([string]$Path)
    $bounds = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VirtualScreen
    $bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $bounds.Width, $bounds.Height
    $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
    try {
        $graphics.CopyFromScreen($bounds.Left, $bounds.Top, 0, 0, $bounds.Size)
        $bitmap.Save($Path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    }
    finally {
        $graphics.Dispose()
        $bitmap.Dispose()
    }
}

$log = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\dell\Documents\powertoollogs' -File |
    Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1
$logStartLength = $log.Length
$started = Get-Date

$mux = Find-Element -ProcessId $process.Id -AutomationId 'mux'
$reserve = Find-Element -ProcessId $process.Id -AutomationId 'alertCKbox'
$clear = Find-Element -ProcessId $process.Id -AutomationId 'clrFaultsbox'
$ok = Find-Element -ProcessId $process.Id -AutomationId 'btnOK'
$muxPattern = $mux.GetCurrentPattern([Windows.Automation.TogglePattern]::Pattern)
$reservePattern = $reserve.GetCurrentPattern([Windows.Automation.TogglePattern]::Pattern)
$clearPattern = $clear.GetCurrentPattern([Windows.Automation.TogglePattern]::Pattern)
$muxState = $muxPattern.Current.ToggleState
$reserveState = $reservePattern.Current.ToggleState
$clearBefore = $clearPattern.Current.ToggleState
if ($muxState -ne [Windows.Automation.ToggleState]::Off) {
    throw "MUX unexpectedly enabled: $muxState"
}
if ($clearBefore -ne [Windows.Automation.ToggleState]::Off) {
    $clearPattern.Toggle()
}

$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(5)
do {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
    $clearPattern = $clear.GetCurrentPattern([Windows.Automation.TogglePattern]::Pattern)
    $clearAfter = $clearPattern.Current.ToggleState
} while ($clearAfter -ne [Windows.Automation.ToggleState]::Off -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline)
if ($clearAfter -ne [Windows.Automation.ToggleState]::Off) {
    throw "CLEAR_FAULTS did not turn off: $clearAfter"
}

$preOk = [ordered]@{
    timestamp = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
    status = 'verified_before_ok'
    process_id = $process.Id
    executable = $process.Path
    mux = [string]$muxState
    reserve_0x0c = [string]$reserveState
    clear_faults_before = [string]$clearBefore
    clear_faults_after = [string]$clearAfter
    ok_invoked = $false
}

Save-DesktopScreenshot -Path (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_rescan_settings_verified.png')

$ok.GetCurrentPattern([Windows.Automation.InvokePattern]::Pattern).Invoke()
$preOk.ok_invoked = $true
$preOk.status = 'scan_started'
$preOk | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8

# The initial scan took about two seconds, but allow a generous read-only window.
Start-Sleep -Seconds 12
$process.Refresh()
if ($process.HasExited) {
    throw "PowerTool exited during scan: $($process.ExitCode)"
}

$log.Refresh()
$delta = ''
if ($log.Length -gt $logStartLength) {
    $stream = [IO.File]::Open($log.FullName, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Read, [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
    try {
        $stream.Seek($logStartLength, [IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin) | Out-Null
        $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($stream, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8, $true)
        try { $delta = $reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
    }
    finally { $stream.Dispose() }
}
$deltaPath = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_rescan_actual_log_delta.txt'
$delta | Set-Content -LiteralPath $deltaPath -Encoding UTF8
$deltaLines = @($delta -split "`r?`n")
$foundAddresses = @(

        ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Matches[0].Groups['address'].Value }
)
$clearActivity = @(

)
$writeActivity = @(

)

$preOk.status = 'completed_readonly'
$preOk.timestamp_end = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
$preOk.found_addresses_decimal = $foundAddresses
$preOk.max15301_seen = [bool]($delta -match 'MAX15301')
$preOk.xml_004328_loaded = [bool]($delta -match 'Xml file loaded:')
$preOk.clear_fault_activity_count = $clearActivity.Count
$preOk.write_activity_count = $writeActivity.Count
$preOk.log_delta = $deltaPath
$preOk.screenshot = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_rescan_completed.png'
Save-DesktopScreenshot -Path $preOk.screenshot
$preOk | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8
$preOk | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4

Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'safe_launch_result.json') -Raw

Write-Output '=== CURRENT LOG ==='
$log = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\dell\Documents\powertoollogs' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Sort-Object LastWriteTime |

if ($null -ne $log) {
    Write-Output ('FILE={0} LEN={1} MTIME={2:o}' -f $log.FullName, $log.Length, $log.LastWriteTime)

$root = [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement

    [Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ProcessIdProperty,
    [int]$process.Id
)
$elements = $root.FindAll([Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $condition)
Write-Output ('ELEMENT_COUNT={0}' -f $elements.Count)
$uiLines = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]
for ($index = 0; $index -lt $elements.Count; $index++) {
    $element = $elements.Item($index)
    $line = '{0}`t{1}`t{2}`t{3}`tEnabled={4}`tOffscreen={5}' -f `

        $element.Current.AutomationId,
        $element.Current.ControlType.ProgrammaticName,

    $uiLines.Add($line)
}

$uiLines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $uiPath -Encoding UTF8
$uiLines |
    Where-Object {

    } |

Write-Output ('UI_EVIDENCE={0}' -f $uiPath)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$resourceFile = 'C:\Users\dell\Downloads\MaximDigitalPower.Properties.Resources.resources'
$reader = New-Object System.Resources.ResourceReader($resourceFile)
try {
    $enumerator = $reader.GetEnumerator()
    $found = $false
    while ($enumerator.MoveNext()) {
        if ([string]$enumerator.Key -ne '004328') {
            continue
        }

        $found = $true
        $xml = [string]$enumerator.Value
        [xml]$document = $xml
        Write-Output ('RESOURCE_KEY={0} CHARS={1}' -f $enumerator.Key, $xml.Length)
        Write-Output ('ROOT={0}' -f $document.DocumentElement.Name)
        $attributes = @(
            $document.DocumentElement.Attributes |

        Write-Output ('ROOT_ATTRS={0}' -f $attributes)

        $preview = $xml.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(1000, $xml.Length)) -replace "`r|`n", ' '
        Write-Output ('XML_PREVIEW={0}' -f $preview)
    }

    if (-not $found) {
        throw '004328 resource missing'
    }
}
finally {

}

do {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultFile) {
        try {
            $result = Get-Content -LiteralPath $resultFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            if ($result.status -in @('running_readonly', 'failed')) {
                break
            }
        }
        catch {
            # The launcher replaces this file atomically, but tolerate a transient read.
        }
    }
} while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)

Write-Output '=== SAFE LAUNCH RESULT ==='
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultFile) {
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $resultFile -Raw
}
else {
    Write-Output 'RESULT_FILE_MISSING'
}

Write-Output '=== SAFE LAUNCH ERROR ==='
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $errorFile) {
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $errorFile -Raw
}
else {
    Write-Output 'NONE'
}

Write-Output '=== TASK ==='
$task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName
$taskInfo = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $taskName
Write-Output ('STATE={0}' -f $task.State)
Write-Output ('LAST_TASK_RESULT=0x{0:X8}' -f [uint32]$taskInfo.LastTaskResult)
Write-Output '=== PROCESS ==='
Get-Process -Name MaximDigitalPower -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Select-Object Id, SessionId, ProcessName, Path, StartTime
